messages:
Maya: Anyone up for a midnight World Cup rematch watch party at the office lounge on Saturday? I can bring a travel speaker and victory confetti. :soccer: :confetti_ball:
Tomas: I9m in if there9s empanadas. Also can we put a 10pm start for the early kickoff?

Riley: Quick poll: empanadas, sliders, or pizza? React with :taco:, :hamburger:, or :pizza:.
snack-bot: Poll created: "Game Night Snacks" (empanadas :taco:, sliders :hamburger:, pizza :pizza:)
Maya: Also thinking tiny fantasy side-game: predict final score, closest guess wins the snack jar. $2 entry. Cheap, chaotic fun.
Tomas: Love it. I9ll take sliders + $2. Someone remind me not to bring my vuvuzela this time.
Leah: I9ll stream if someone can lug the GoPro down stairs. Also volunteer to mock-commentate if needed.
Owen: Can we set a "no work-talk" rule? Last time turned into a 20-min latency debate mid-match. :sweat_smile:
Riley: Agreed. Full banter-only zone. Tickets: Maya @maya, Tomas @tomas, Leah @leah, Owen @owen, Riley @riley.
snack-bot: Reminder: "Midnight Match & Snacks" Sat 22:00 added to calendar.
